description: Read the opt-in per-job Project To-do surface. Pass jobId for the employer view (categories, item definitions, roster without emails, all assignments) or contractId for an EXACT contract read: the worker's own effective list + history and blocking state, or for employers exactly that contract's assignments in every status, a roster of one (even when the contract is ended/offboarded/closed; empty when no worker is linked), and the `contract` lifecycle projection (null on job-wide reads; never names other contracts). assignedTo is the employer alias for contractId (requires jobId); a jobId supplied with a contract selector must match the contract's job for workers and employers alike (BAD_REQUEST CONTRACT_JOB_MISMATCH) and never widens the read. Cursor-paged with stable assignment ids and immutable per-assignment evidence/event audit history. Disabled jobs read as enabled=false with an empty, inert surface. Requires project_todos:read scope, the default-off project-todos agent surface, and a claimed account.

all.description: true collects EVERY page: follows nextCursor to exhaustion at a contract-valid page size (limit caps each page, never above 100; cursor may seed the start) and returns collection metadata {pageSize, pagesFetched, collectedCount, complete, finalCursor} alongside the merged result. Use this for job/project sweeps instead of raising limit past the documented maximum.

assignedTo.description: Employer job view: filter to one contract id.

contractId.description: Contract id for the worker's effective list + history and blocking state.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page (nextCursor). Omit for the first page.

includeArchived.description: Include archived logical items/categories in the employer catalog.

itemId.description: Filter assignments by logical item id.

jobId.description: Job id for the employer view (catalog + roster + all assignments).

needsReview.description: true returns only submitted assignments awaiting employer review.

status.description: Filter assignments by status: SCHEDULED (gated pre-activation work — employer views only; worker views NEVER return never-activated assignments), OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, SUBMITTED, COMPLETED, RETURNED, WAIVED, CLOSED, or SUPERSEDED.

name: opentrain_list_project_todos
